package main // Cart changes its tracked map and slice in place, with Go's builtins. type Cart struct { ui.Live items map[string]int slots []string meta Meta } func (c *Cart) Add(name string, n int) { if c.items == nil { c.items = map[string]int{} } c.items[name] += n } func (c *Cart) Remove(name string) { delete(c.items, name) } func (c *Cart) Empty() { clear(c.items) } func (c *Cart) Fill(names []string) { c.slots = make([]string, len(names)) copy(c.slots, names) } func (c *Cart) Untag(t string) { delete(c.meta.Tags, t) }

{len(meta.Tags)} tags, {len(items)} items, {len(slots)} slots
